title: Normal AI workflow: examine, bounded edit, semantic scan, impact, qualification, explicit acceptance
summary: The preferred AI cycle is Gopher context/symbol/source examination -> bounded stale-fenced edit -> language rules -> executable read-only SSC status/identity/compare/impact -> focused tests/package checks -> explicit reviewer acceptance. Mutating SSC authority remains separate.
procedure: Open the active project sphere and this SSC sphere.
Locate the exact declaration with source.symbol.lookup and examine the bounded source.
Use source.oorexx.method.edit (or language-specific bounded editor) with expected SHA-256 fencing; preserve unrelated bytes.
Use source.semantic.status/identify/compare/impact/source/proposals through the Finder-authorised SSC adapter; these operations are read-only projections over SSC authority.
Use SSC impact plus Gopher test.impact.discover to choose qualification; SSC semantic impact is structural evidence, Gopher test impact is advisory discovery.
Acceptance and proposal decisions remain separate reviewer/admin authority actions and are not executable through the read adapter.
invariants: Never regenerate an existing source file from a partial model.
Never infer acceptance from a green validator, test, package check or Gopher result.
Never hide a Gopher escape that qualification depended on.
